title: Myth flip — awareness went backwards (Nadia, 46, and the stairs)
caption:
Myth: awareness only goes up. In the US it fell — 65% of women knew heart disease was their #1 killer in 2009, 44% by 2019 (AHA, Circulation 2021).
Which myth should we flip next? 👇
www.aiforheratx.org
#womensheart #heartdisease #womenshealth #hearthealth #healthmyths

scenes.text: In women a heart attack often arrives as jaw ache, nausea, or flat *exhaustion*.
phrases: The myth: heart trouble is a man's illness.
It is the leading cause of death in women.
And in women it often looks like jaw ache, nausea, or flat exhaustion.

scenes.text: Write the two symptoms and the times they hit, then ask for the *score*.
phrases: Write down the two symptoms and the exact times they hit.
Take that page in and ask for your ASCVD 10-year risk score.
Walk 22 minutes a day — that adds up to the WHO's 150 a week.
